summary: The agent sets up a reasonable baseline using 5-fold cross-validation, LightGBM, and appropriate domain-specific feature engineering. However, it fails to track the required task metric (ROC AUC) on the validation sets and omits early stopping callbacks, risking severe overfitting across the 1000 estimators. Additionally, it relies entirely on the model to handle missing values and combines fold predictions using a naive unweighted average.
